credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: A large, red maple tree swirls through much of the left and central portions of this work.  To the right, a dark cone-shaped tree ascends along the painting's border, while yellow trees are visible in the background.  The uppermost portion of the background is colored in shades of gray.
